description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different models, comparing their performance. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, with labels "RoBERTa w/o Exp.", "ExEnt", "LaSQuE (mean)", "LaSQuE", and "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)". The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 40% to 65%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. Each category is represented by a bar, with "RoBERTa w/o Exp." having a value of approximately 46%, "ExEnt" at around 55%, "LaSQuE (mean)" and "LaSQuE" both at about 47%, and "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)" at approximately 62%. The bars are colored according to a legend, with "RoBERTa w/o Exp." in white, "ExEnt" in light blue, "LaSQuE (mean)" in orange, "LaSQuE" in green, and "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)" in dark purple. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart presents a straightforward comparison of the accuracy percentages across the different models.
